title: ‘Close Enough’ Data Breach Notifications Create Exposure
content_md: Vaughn Stupart, Matthew W. Van Hise, and Craig A. Hoffman of BakerHostetler write: One ruling is not a trend. And there can be unique factors at play in regulatory investigations related to large incidents.
